title: Gradient Fighter - Pictos Effect & Location (Expedition 33)

facts.label: Location
facts.value: Lumiere Act III - near the enemy group by the Gardens

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Gradient Fighter is a Pictos in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33. Effect: Increases Gradient Charge generation.

sections.title: How to Get Gradient Fighter
sections.content: Location: Lumiere Act III - near the enemy group by the Gardens.

sections.title: Is It Worth Equipping?
sections.content: Pictos unlock a Lumina after four battles, so equipping it once is enough to keep the effect permanently available for the Lumina cost.
